rules: a mechanism, metric, workflow, or framing directly present in prior art cannot become novel by bundling it with other published components
a different implementation substrate such as KV state versus text does not by itself create conceptual novelty
an empirical law remains only a hypothesis until prospectively held-out prediction and causal intervention outperform all direct baselines
unavailable code weakens reproducibility but never restores novelty
no architecture experiment is justified solely to rescue a claim already classified as direct overlap

monotone cost-conditioned structural attention control from one checkpoint is explicit
distribution-aware exact checkpoint placement for recurrent/hybrid prefixes is explicit
retrieval-reasoning profiles already guide global layer/head cache allocation
routing, GER, consensus, token graphs, and survive-but-not-used failure are explicit
one helpful proposition per distinct hop document and Full versus Partial all-hop evidence are explicit
answerability, missing-subquestion generation, and iterative targeted accumulation are explicit
oracle-plus-distractor contexts, source helpfulness, user budgets, one-hop omission, and whole-pipeline cost are explicit
supporting/conflicting evidence and reasoning paths are compressed per answer candidate after search, not predicted from internal state before output

n1_required_distinction.predict: unseen layouts, dependency templates, source loads, at least one scale, and one different recurrent/cache representation
baselines: independent layer sensitivity and greedy replacement
n1_required_distinction.causal_requirement: intervene on predicted integration, refresh, or readout roles at fixed count/state/FLOPs and move both diagnostic and held-out quality
n1_required_distinction.falsification: wrong held-out ranking, unstable coefficients, no intervention response, or no gain beyond count/final-layer baselines rejects the law
